items.headline: Chiefs rule Rashee Rice doubtful to return after injury
items.description: Kansas City Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice sustained a right hamstring injury in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders, and was ruled doubtful to return after halftime.
